t: 2032 — First long-duration altitude control testbed runs a sealed cloud
title: 2032 — First long-duration altitude control testbed runs a sealed cloud
definition: 2032 milestone on the Venus Cloud Colonies roadmap.
description:
First long-duration altitude control testbed runs a sealed cloud hulls habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the aerostat habitats recycling math.

What must be true first: the aerostat habitats results have to replicate outside the lab, colony logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and acid resistance operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed aerostat habitats demonstrations, colony logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting acid resistance uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Venus Cloud Colonies
definition: Estimates Venus Cloud Colonies readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Venus Cloud Colonies components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a cloud hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Venus Cloud Colonies Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Venus Cloud Colonies operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Venus Cloud Colonies installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 20412 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where aerostat habitats monitoring, colony logistics redundancy, or acid resistance maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Venus Cloud Colonies Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Venus Cloud Colonies: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Venus Cloud Colonies — floating cities in the temperate clouds of Venus.

Phase 1 — Prove (aerostat habitats): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (colony logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (acid resistance): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (altitude control): cloud hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and Venusian clouds-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
